Each changed Oracle card is counted once. Changes can include rules text, format legality, or card data such as produced mana and related cards. Printing changes can include finishes and variants. Set changes cover names and release dates. Rulings are compared by card, date and text, so a rewritten ruling counts as one removal and one addition.
